answer: The walnut index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the shale queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1900 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the bridge. Each impostor pays 7 dollars up front. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
